task: Repair the rejected BioFabric STEP-02 interchange custody commit in place. You own only crates/core/src/io/align.rs, annotation.rs, attribute.rs, factory.rs, gw.rs, json.rs, order.rs, sif.rs, and xml.rs, including their existing private source-module tests. Do not edit public types/traits/signatures, manifests, lockfiles, fixtures, external tests, other source paths, Git metadata, or workflow artifacts. Preserve the already-correct BIF `annot tag` writer behavior, optional annotation colors, normal/shadow drain-zone round trips including empty containers, metadata, NetAlign scores, display/session/plugin raw state, and factory routing. Make the smallest complete corrections established by the review: (1) SIF must never silently drop declared targets or return a partial successful import for malformed records; support an isolated node and a source/relation/one-or-more-targets record only, preserving each target deterministically, and reject incomplete records; (2) node/link order readers must retain declared row/column positions, produce the declared order deterministically, reject duplicate/invalid positions, and parse writer-emitted `shdw(...)` relations without corruption; (3) attributes must require a valid header and reject duplicate column names or node records rather than overwriting; (4) JSON serialization must be byte-deterministic for equivalent fixed model data despite HashMap attributes; (5) GW must reject nonblank trailing payload and must not silently coerce mixed per-link directedness into its graph-level directed flag; (6) XML must preserve separate regular link normal/shadow-on and no-shadow columns, reject duplicate node names as well as duplicate nids, preserve an explicit empty layout as Some(layout), and fully decode standard/numeric XML attribute entities; (7) strengthen the existing XML scanner/parser so malformed or unbalanced documents fail at ParseError and only established BIF annotations (`<annot tag=...>`) are accepted, while retaining supported raw plugin/session data rather than rejecting valid plugin payload. Do not introduce a new external dependency or alternative file format. Add focused private source-module regression tests for every repaired behavior where practical. Run only focused non-Docker source checks available to the worker; do not invoke Docker, a verifier, or Git. Write a truthful RESULT.json with exact paths, test results, and uncertainty. ROOT will inspect the staged diff, run pinned bridge checks, and obtain a fresh independent review before acceptance.
acceptance_criteria: Only the nine named I/O source files and their existing in-file tests are modified; fixed APIs and protected paths remain unchanged.

Malformed SIF/order/attribute/GW/XML input reaches the existing ParseError boundary without a partial successful result, while valid SIF multi-target records and writer output round-trip without loss.

Serialization is deterministic and lossless within each supported format: JSON attributes, GW direction semantics, declared order positions, XML normal/no-shadow link columns, explicit empty layouts, identities, and XML entities all preserve their fixed model meaning.
The BIF-standard annotation and drain-zone behaviors already repaired remain covered and passing; plugin/session state is not discarded by structural XML validation.
Focused source-module regressions cover the repaired parser/writer edge cases where practical, and RESULT.json truthfully reports evidence and limitations.
deliverables: Scoped I/O parser/serializer repairs with focused in-module regression tests.
A truthful RESULT.json with changed paths, verification, and remaining uncertainty.
reason_for_acceptance_and_deliverables: A valid independent review and ROOT corroboration found material I/O loss and malformed-input defects. This resume narrowly repairs those findings while preserving the BIF/session behavior already established in the custody commit.
